data.body: REJECTED_BY_ORCHESTRATOR — Agent reported STATUS:pass but 4 of 6 tests in test_reconcile_main.py fail with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'plugins'. Root cause: unittest.mock.patch() targets use 'plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler._advisory_lock.<fn>' but the 'plugins' directory is not a Python package. The fix requires seeding sys.modules with namespace ModuleType entries for plugins, plugins.dso, plugins.dso.scripts, plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler before patch() can resolve the target. Reverting to open for re-dispatch with this constraint surfaced.
